name: aml
description: automix-light — automix's light edition for beginners. One goal: fast, accurate implementation. An interview (KK/KU/UK/UU) surfaces decision points you didn't know you had and builds spec.md (/aml:new); implement task.md in order, verifying and logging to progress.md in plain words (/aml:go); check progress (/aml:status). md-first — the only script is observe.py for observability (per-task model·time·tokens·cost to progress.md, optional Langfuse export). /aml:doctor for a pre-start check.
